Strategy already near-optimal leverage; higher base pushes trending regimes into steeper DD penalty zone.

exp: linreg exit with pos_pnl>0.005 gate -- stability WORSENED -0.001 (0.705->0.704). CRITICAL FINDING: position-state-dependent gates (entry_prices) AMPLIFY divergence. exp: broad linreg exit-to-flat (0.0004 slope, no gates) + 5-bar dedicated cooldown -- stability WORSENED -0.007 (ALL regimes). Rally DD +6.94pp (exits during pullbacks, re-enters at worse prices). EXIT-TO-FLAT is fundamentally worse than FLIP for stability (brief convergence vs sustained).

exp: asymmetric trending linreg exit for longs + wider sideways gate -- stability UNCHANGED (0.717). Stability PROGRESS but fails DD cap (all regimes +6-11pp).

exp: isolated 2-bar momentum smoothing -- stability WORSENED -0.009. 0.5-bar lag shifts noise sensitivity to different bars rather than eliminating it. Sideways -0.012 (misses quick oscillations). Rally +0.015 (only regime helped). Smoothing does NOT reduce aggregate noise, just relocates it.
